concept.title: Extracting Agreement Data Using Contract Intelligence for CLM

conbody.p: Contract Intelligence is a new web user interface feature that works on the CLM platform. Contract Intelligence is a machine-learning application that reads documents, finds key provisions, and analyzes the characteristics of your contracts and third-party paper.

After a document has been processed by Contract Intelligence, you can view the extractions in CLM. Then you can check out the processed document using X-Author for Contracts, edit the document using X-Author for Contract functionalities, and reconcile it.
